expressions: Oscillating horizontal wind creates a visible, slow left-right underwater sway

_rationale: A single Trapcode Particular system provides a wide bottom emitter, buoyant upward motion, cyan glow spheres, and a moderate persistent population. Air resistance unlocks a sinusoidal wind plus low-complexity turbulence, preventing perfectly vertical paths while retaining small readable bubbles against the near-black deep-blue background.
pass_criteria: small round bubble-like particles rising from the bottom region
blue-cyan palette on a deep dark blue background
lateral sway visible — trajectories not perfectly vertical

applied.why: Increase horizontal wind amplitude so the rising paths show a clearly visible slow left-right sway rather than reading as nearly vertical drift.
Strengthen broad turbulence enough to add organic lateral curvature to individual bubble trajectories.
Slightly raise the continuous birth rate so the early portion of the animation is less empty while retaining readable individual particles.
